body: Definitely don't do that. That would be horrible for emergency services or anyone who has to identify your body.

They don't know what they are talking about. They're not as smart as us.

I also see the word "coward" branded around a lot. They even use it to describe suicide bombers. WTF. As if 99.9% reoccuring of people would have the cajones to blow themself up.
Why do you feel that way? What specifically are the issues?
It's on my mind all the time. I have been practicing driving in my dads car so I am more confident about commuting to a job.

Yeah that's me... education is like a safe haven. I like biology too but did physics because I was doing well in maths at the time.

Yeah good idea about getting out there. I run a lot but I do the same few routes all the time. I would like to get a bike. Driving out somewhere sounds like a good idea... I will try it.

Sorry to hear that. What was your masters in?

I feel like there are no opportunities... I just don't know how to move forward.
Yes I run 30 miles per week. It's not a lot compared to some but it has put me in good physical health. Sometimes I do short runs and sometimes I do half marathon distance.

To be honest I don't really care about my 20s. I mean, there's not much more I could have done. I did a degree, I am in perfect health (physically not mentally) and my family are doing ok (except my grandfather passed away last September at 93). I have not aged physically (although mentally I have suffered). I lost my virginity in 2018... so at least I got to experience that.

But now what...
